messages:
Kai: dropping a short thread on the vectors preview + export UI — focusing on fallback behavior when a rerank model is missing, CSV vs JSONL clarity, and small accessibility nits. figma: https://figma.com/file/xyz-export-clarity
Kai: Key UX points: how to label missing rerank columns, wording for per-file limits, keyboard order, and export filename defaults.
Mira - Eng: backend note: if rerank metadata is absent for some rows we can either emit empty cells or omit the column. emitting empty cells keeps schema stable which is better for downstream tooling.
Olen (PM): Product preference: stable schema — emit columns with empty values and add a small footnote: 'Columns present even if some rows lack values.' Also show a tooltip on rerank toggle explaining this.
Sofia - A11y: tiny nits: tooltip must be keyboard focusable and have role='tooltip'. the footnote should be referenced by aria-describedby on the toggle. ensure contrast for the footnote text.
Kai: Copy suggestion for the column header: 'Rerank score (if available)'. Thoughts?
Mira - Eng: fine. Also recommend adding an exported metadata column 'rerank_model' so consumers can know which model produced the score per row. empty string if not present.
Olen (PM): yes include rerank_model. default toggle state: off for GA, on in canary. We want telemetry on how often people need rerank metadata.
Kai: File splitting language — I'm leaning to 'Files are split into parts of up to 10,000 rows. Parts are zipped for download.' Less scary than 'limited to'.
Sofia - A11y: wording ok. add aria-live announcement when user changes rows-per-file so SRs know the number of parts changes.
Mira - Eng: implementation: we'll show live estimate: rows selected, rows/file, estimated total size. We'll attach a small info icon with accessible description.
Olen (PM): Filename preview: show editable input default '<dataset>-vectors-<model>-YYYYMMDD', and if split show '<base>.part1.csv.gz'. Allow user edit and reflect in preview.
Kai: Edge case: mixed embedding dims -> export should fail with an error listing example row ids. Better than silent normalization.
Mira - Eng: agreed. We'll surface error and link to docs for how to handle mixed dims.
Sofia - A11y: progress UI: use aria-live polite for updates and ensure cancel is keyboard reachable. announce final download link with SR-friendly text.
Kai: Small copy tweak for relevance table header: 'Relevance score — higher means more relevant' (shorter than previous).
Olen (PM): final asks before I update figma: - header copy for modal (short, include formats) - include rerank_model + rerank_score columns with stable schema - footnote copy about empty cells - rows-per-file language (10k) + live estimate - filename preview editable - a11y IDs for footnote & progress
Mira - Eng: I'll file backend ticket INF-9012 for zip + per-part gzip + stable columns.
Sofia - A11y: I'll run a quick keyboard + SR pass after figma update; will add checklist for tooltips, aria-live, and contrast.
Devops-bot: snapshot uploaded: https://redwood.design/snapshots/1781234567
Kai: thanks team — I'll update figma and lock copy in a follow-up thread. :sparkles:
